Result: 30/30 PASS in 10.87s after one tiny test fix and one one-line storage.py fix. Legacy regression suites (iter25, user_management, notifications, image_storage) re-run clean: 56/57 pass — the only failure is a stale test asserting 7 modules instead of the now-required 9 (test_user_management.py::test_modules_returns_seven_keys). rca of the issue: Refactor regression: storage.py read `EMERGENT_KEY = os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY')` at module-import time (line 14). New server.py top-of-file does `from storage import …` (line 19) BEFORE `from deps import …` (line 22). deps.py is what calls load_dotenv at import. So when storage.py was imported, .env had not been loaded yet, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY was None, the captured `EMERGENT_KEY` constant was None, and every call to init_storage() raised RuntimeError → 502 'Image upload failed'. Mitigation: replaced module-level constant with a `_emergent_key()` helper that reads os.environ at call time. Verified by re-running test_iter27 (image upload + serve now 200/200) and test_image_storage.py (all green).
